items.t: Lower intake manifold gasket coolant leak
items.job: Replace lower intake manifold gaskets and refill coolant
items.note: Owners report $800–$1,500. Add an oil change if coolant got into the oil.

items.t: Overheating that leads to head gasket or cylinder head damage
items.job: Replace head gaskets (and cylinder head if cracked)
items.note: Owners report about $1,100–$1,300 for head gasket work and up to $3,200 when overheating did more damage.

items.t: Automatic transmission jerking, hard shifts or failure
items.job: Replace pressure control solenoid, or rebuild/replace the transaxle
items.note: Owners report $2,100–$2,700 on average for rebuilds; a used unit costs less.

items.t: Shudder on the 1-2 shift
items.job: Replace second clutch assembly or recondition valve body

items.t: Power sliding door can open while driving (recall)
items.job: Free dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.t: Power sliding door can push a passenger's arm (recall)
items.job: Free dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.t: Power sliding door won't open, close or latch
items.job: Repair power sliding door motor, cable or latch
items.note: Fixing a switch or adjustment costs much less.

items.t: Dead battery from power sliding door
items.job: Parasitic drain test and door circuit repair

items.t: Tapping noise from the engine
items.job: Replace rocker arms, bolts and lifters as needed
items.note: Owners report about $1,600 on average; internal engine damage costs far more.

items.t: Dash gauges and fuel gauge read wrong
items.job: Repair or replace instrument cluster
items.note: Owners report about $700. If the fuel sender is at fault, the tank must be lowered.

items.t: Fuel tank check valve can leak fuel (recall)
items.job: Free dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.t: Steering can get hard to turn (recall)
items.job: Free dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.t: Wiper linkage can rub a brake line (recall)
items.job: Free dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.t: Bucket seat release can injure fingers (recall)
items.job: Free dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.t: ABS or traction control light on
items.job: Replace wheel speed sensor or repair wiring
items.note: An ABS module repair costs more.

items.t: Weak heat at idle in cold weather
items.job: Cooling system service and heater flow repair
items.note: A heater core replacement, if needed, costs $1,090–$1,440.

items.t: A/C weak in hot weather or noisy compressor clutch
items.job: A/C diagnosis and compressor clutch repair

items.t: Water leaks at the windshield or overhead console
items.job: Water-test and reseal windshield or console area

items.t: Headlights fog up or lenses come loose
items.job: Replace headlamp assembly

items.t: Power window switch fails
items.job: Replace power window switch
